title: CRM Automation Manager
description:
We're working with an established organisation that is looking to strengthen its digital marketing function with the appointment of an experienced CRM Automation Manager.

This is a confidential opportunity, with further information about the organisation available during the recruitment process.

The role will suit someone who enjoys combining marketing technology, automation, data and customer journeys to improve engagement and generate stronger commercial results.

The role

You'll take ownership of marketing automation activity across prospect and customer journeys, ensuring campaigns are well planned, effectively executed and continually optimised.

You'll work closely with marketing, sales, digital and other internal stakeholders to improve lead management, customer engagement and overall marketing performance.

Key responsibilities
- Manage and optimise automated marketing campaigns and customer journeys.
- Develop nurture programmes across key prospect and customer touchpoints.
- Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Use automation and emerging technology to improve lead management and engagement.
- Produce regular performance reporting against agreed targets.
- Plan and implement testing programmes to improve campaign performance.
- Develop automated communication across multiple customer touchpoints and channels.
- Improve the quality and effectiveness of leads passed to commercial teams.
- Work with internal stakeholders to improve customer engagement and retention.
- Regularly review and maintain marketing data, ensuring strong data quality and segmentation.
- Support the development of integrations between marketing, CRM and other business systems.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and technology.
- Keep up to date with developments across marketing technology and automation.
- Work with senior marketing stakeholders to support wider growth objectives.

About you

We're looking for someone with strong experience in marketing automation and campaign management, ideally within a commercially focused environment.

You'll need:
- Strong hands-on experience across marketing automation and CRM technology.
- Experience managing automated customer and prospect journeys.
- Good understanding of lead scoring, segmentation and attribution.
- Experience working with CRM and marketing technology integrations.
- Strong analytical skills and a data-led approach to decision making.
- Experience using testing and optimisation to improve campaign performance.
- An interest in AI and emerging marketing technology.
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- A proactive approach with the confidence to challenge existing processes and suggest new ideas.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against deadlines.

What's on offer
- Salary up to 50,000
- Manchester location
- Monday-Friday, 9am-5:30pm
- Competitive holiday allowance
- Pension
- Healthcare and wellbeing support
- Life assurance
- Employee discounts and lifestyle benefits
- Flexible wellbeing and employee support initiatives
- Opportunities to develop and influence the wider marketing function

This is a confidential appointment, so further details about the organisation will be provided to suitable candidates during the recruitment process.

The Portfolio Group are acting on behalf of our client in recruiting for this position.

title: Junior Marketing Designer
description:
Junior Marketing Designer

Location: Manchester
Salary: 23,000+ DOE
Contract: Permanent Full-Time
Level: Junior / Entry-Level

Looking to kick-start your career in Marketing & Design?

Calibre Search is working with an established, growing environmental consultancy in Manchester that is looking to recruit a creative and enthusiastic Junior Marketing Designer to join its Marketing Team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who has a passion for graphic design, social media, digital marketing and content creation.

You'll work alongside experienced marketing professionals, gaining hands-on experience across a variety of creative projects while helping develop the company's brand, online presence and marketing campaigns.

Whether you're a recent graduate, have some initial marketing experience or have developed your creative skills through personal projects, we'd love to hear from you!

The Role

As a Junior Marketing Designer, you'll support the wider Marketing Team in delivering engaging content across digital and traditional marketing channels.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Creating eye-catching social media graphics, animations and digital content.
- Supporting the planning, creation and scheduling of social media posts across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
- Designing marketing materials including brochures, presentations, infographics and promotional content.
- Assisting with photography, videography and video editing for marketing campaigns.
- Supporting website updates, blog content and digital communications.
- Helping develop creative campaigns to increase brand awareness and engagement.
- Monitoring social media trends and identifying opportunities for fresh, engaging content.
- Supporting recruitment marketing and employer branding initiatives.
- Working with colleagues across the business to bring creative ideas to life.
- Ensuring marketing materials remain consistent with company branding.

About You

We're looking for someone creative, motivated and eager to develop their skills within a supportive marketing environment.

Ideally, you'll have:
- A genuine interest in graphic design, marketing, branding and social media.
- Basic experience using design software such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva or similar.
- A good understanding of social media platforms and current digital trends.
- Strong written communication skills and an eye for detail.
- An interest in photography, videography and content creation.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- A positive attitude, creative mindset and willingness to learn.

Desirable but not essential:
- A qualification in Marketing, Graphic Design, Digital Media or a related subject.
- Experience creating social media content, whether professionally, academically or personally.
- Familiarity with Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, CapCut or Premiere Pro.
- Basic knowledge of SEO, social media analytics or digital marketing tools.
- A portfolio showcasing creative projects, designs or digital content.

Previous professional marketing experience isn't essential. We're equally interested in candidates who can demonstrate creativity, enthusiasm and a willingness to develop.

What's on Offer?
- Starting salary of 23,000+, depending on experience.
- Opportunity to join an established and growing environmental consultancy.
- Hands-on experience across graphic design, social media and digital marketing.
- Support and guidance from an experienced Marketing Team.
- Exposure to a wide variety of creative projects and campaigns.
- Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your marketing career.
- A collaborative working environment where your ideas and creativity are encouraged.

Interested?

If you're a creative individual looking to take your first steps in marketing or develop your existing design skills, this could be the perfect opportunity.

Apply today or get in touch with Ben Dakin at Calibre Search, for a confidential discussion and further details.

Calibre Search promote equality in the workplace and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified candidates regardless of their sex, race, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age. We act as both an employment agency and employment business.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive - Commercial Buildings
Location Manchester
Salary - £37,000 + Benefits
Job Type Permanent, based on site

Love bringing places to life? Our Client, a leading national property and facilities management business, is looking for a creative and organised Marketing individual to transform a busy community shopping centre into a destination people genuinely want to visit.
Working with a specialist placemaking team, you will plan and deliver events, campaigns and community initiatives that put people first, build local pride and support the long-term success of the centre.
The role Reporting to the Centre Manager, you will develop and deliver placemaking and enlivenment strategies that create a thriving, welcoming destination. You will build a year-round programme of events and initiatives that engage shoppers, occupiers and the local community, touching on wellbeing, diversity and inclusion, and social value, and at times extending into retail and public realm spaces.
This is a hands-on role. You will manage day-to-day activity, make sure events are set up and delivered safely and on time, and turn ideas into reality, supported by specialist placemaking colleagues and the wider property and facilities management team.
What you will be doing
Creating Experiences
- Contribute to placemaking strategies and budgets alongside the placemaking specialists, centre management and client team.
- Plan, coordinate and deliver events and enlivenment activity, keeping projects on track and on time.
- Design community engagement initiatives and support community-led projects.
- Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive successful outcomes.

Marketing and Communications
- Write copy and create content for apps, posters, digital screens, email campaigns and social media.
- Own the centres communications plan across print and digital channels.

Insight and Reporting
- Research customer needs and recommend new initiatives.
- Track performance and report on key metrics, including mystery shopping, journey mapping and the annual customer survey.
- Produce reports and presentations for the client and internal stakeholders.
- Help put the centre forward for awards and accreditations, gathering content for submissions.

Health and Safety
- Review health and safety submissions for events, filming and tenant activity before and during delivery.
- Make sure the right licences are in place and that event contractors follow site procedures from set-up to break-down.
- Support the centre in maintaining its ISO 45001 accreditation.

Ideal Candidate
- A proven track record of delivering successful events and community engagement, both in person and online.
- Excellent written communication and report-writing skills.
- Confident with Microsoft Office, websites, newsletters and social media platforms.
- A good understanding of health and safety legislation. IOSH Managing Safely is an advantage, or you must be committed to gaining it.
- Highly organised, able to juggle multiple tasks and work to tight deadlines with a keen eye for detail.
- A self-starter who can work on your own initiative without close supervision.
- Flexible, friendly and cooperative, with a real drive to improve performance and deliver great results.

How to apply If you are a creative, organised events or marketing professional who loves bringing places to life, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and send your CV to (url removed) at Joshua Robert.
INDS

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Performance Marketing Manager

Job type: Temporary Contract Approximately 6 months

Contract details: One week's notice period. The contract may be extended beyond the initial six months, subject to performance

About Crystal Ball

Crystal Ball is an innovative, family-owned business offering next-generation fleet management and intelligence, built in an intuitive and customisable award-winning ecosystem. Combining powerful, future-proof technology with uncompromising customer service, Crystal Ball helps businesses transform fleet performance, reduce risks, and deliver measurable cost savings.

Following a sustained period of growth, we are now seeking an experienced and commercially minded Performance Marketing Manager to play a pivotal role in the next stage of our journey. This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of our performance marketing activity, drive high-quality lead generation, optimise customer acquisition, and deliver measurable growth across multiple digital channels.

The role

As Performance Marketing Manager, you will plan, execute and optimise multi-channel performance marketing campaigns that generate leads, drive conversions and deliver a strong return on marketing investment.

With a particular focus on paid advertising, PPC, social media advertising and outbound lead generation, you will take a hands-on approach to campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and display networks.

Using data, testing and insight, you will continually improve performance, identify new acquisition opportunities and maximise marketing spend, working closely with the sales team to align activity with commercial objectives.

Key responsibilities
- Develop and execute the company's performance marketing strategy, with a focus on lead generation, customer acquisition and revenue growth.
- Plan, manage and optimise PPC campaigns across Google Ads, including Search, Display, Performance Max and remarketing.
- Manage paid social campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
- Manage cold outreach and outbound marketing campaigns across email, LinkedIn and other prospecting platforms to generate new business opportunities.
- Identify and test new advertising platforms, channels, audiences and campaign strategies to expand reach and improve acquisition performance.
- Manage advertising budgets, bidding strategies and campaign spend to maximise return on investment.
- Develop and optimise landing pages, marketing funnels and conversion paths to improve lead generation and conversion rates.
- Implement A/B testing across ad creative, messaging, audiences, landing pages and calls to action.
- Track key performance metrics including cost per lead (CPL), conversion rates, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and return on ad spend (ROAS).
- Manage CRM integration, conversion tracking, attribution and marketing automation to ensure accurate reporting and effective lead management.
- Produce regular performance reports, providing clear insights and recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness.
- Manage relationships with external agencies, suppliers and advertising partners where required.

Skills and experience
- 6+ years' experience in a performance marketing or paid media role within a B2 B environment.
- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, including Search, Display, Performance Max and remarketing.
- Demonstrable experience managing Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
- Experience using LinkedIn Campaign Manager for B2 B lead generation and audience targeting.
- Experience with cold outreach, email prospecting and LinkedIn outreach tools and platforms.
- Strong understanding of display advertising, retargeting, audience segmentation and conversion funnels.
- Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking and attribution.
- Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM and marketing automation platforms.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and turn insights into actionable improvements.
- Ability to develop compelling ad copy, campaign messaging and creative briefs.
- Highly organised, commercially minded and comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously.

What success looks like
- Consistent growth in qualified inbound and outbound lead generation.
- Reduced cost per lead and improved customer acquisition costs.
- Increased conversion rates across advertising campaigns and landing pages.
- Improved return on advertising spend and overall marketing investment.
- Successful acquisition of new customers through multiple paid and outbound channels.
- Improved lead quality and increased conversion of marketing-generated leads into sales opportunities.
- Effective use of marketing data, tracking and attribution to inform decision-making.
- Identification and development of new channels and opportunities to support business growth.

What we offer
- Competitive salary of £40,000 - £45,000 per annum, dependent on experience and qualifications.
- Performance-related bonus opportunities.
- Ongoing professional development and training.
- Opportunity to shape and grow the digital marketing function.
- A collaborative and innovative working environment.
- Annual leave entitlement of 20 days, plus bank holidays.

Location: Based at our Manchester head office 5 days a week Monday to Friday. Remote working is not available.

Reporting to: Managing Director

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Social Media Executive

Location: Manchester

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Salary: £28,000 £30,000

Closing Date: 11th December

We re looking for a creative, ambitious and commercially minded Social Media Executive to join our Marketing Team at UA92.

This is a great opportunity for someone who loves social media, understands what makes different audiences tick and wants to take ownership of how a growing higher education provider shows up online.

We re looking for someone who can help us tell that story.

The Role

As our Social Media Executive, you ll support on developing and delivering our social media activity, helping us reach prospective students, grow our online communities and turn engagement into student enquiries and applications.

You ll have the freedom to bring new ideas to the table, experiment with content and shape how UA92 is represented across our social channels.

This isn t just about creating great content. We want someone who understands the bigger picture, can use data to make decisions and knows how social media can contribute to student recruitment and business growth.

You ll be responsible for:
- Developing and delivering UA92 s social media strategy across our key platforms.
- Creating engaging, original content that brings our students, people and campuses to life.
- Planning, managing and optimising paid social campaigns, making sure we re getting the best return on investment.
- Keeping on top of emerging trends, platforms and content formats, and identifying opportunities to try something different.
- Managing our social media communities, building relationships and encouraging meaningful engagement.
- Using analytics and audience insight to understand what s working, what isn t and where we can improve.
- Working closely with colleagues across UA92 to identify stories and opportunities that support our recruitment and brand objectives.
- Supporting and managing our student social media interns and content creators, giving students a genuine voice in our content.

About You

We re looking for someone equally comfortable coming up with creative ideas as they are looking at campaign performance and making recommendations.

You ll understand that successful social media is about reaching the right people, creating content that connects with them and delivering results.

Ideally, you ll bring:
- Experience developing and delivering social media strategies and managing organisational social media accounts.
- Strong content creation and copywriting skills, with a good understanding of what works across different platforms.
- Experience managing paid social campaigns, including budgets, audience targeting and optimisation.
- A good understanding of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
- Confidence using analytics and reporting tools to measure performance and inform future activity.
- Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and priorities.
- The confidence to share your ideas, challenge existing approaches and work with colleagues across different teams.
- A degree in Marketing, Communications or a related subject, or equivalent professional experience.

Why UA92

UA92 isn t a traditional university, and we re not looking for someone who wants to do things simply because that s how they ve always been done.

We re a growing organisation with big ambitions, and you ll have a real opportunity to influence our social media approach, bring your ideas to life and see the impact of your work.

Our values are at the heart of how we work We Care. We re Inclusive. We re Brave and Bold.

If you re creative, curious, comfortable trying new things and want to work somewhere you can make a genuine difference, we d love to hear from you.

UA92 is committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, respected and able to succeed. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Social Media Manager (Podcasts / Video)
description:
Social Media Manager (Podcasts / Video)

Are you a creative storyteller with a passion for social media, video, and podcast production? Do you thrive in fast paced environments where no two days look the same? If so, this could be the perfect next step in your career.

We re looking for a Social Media Manager to join our growing team and help shape the online presence of a diverse portfolio of B2 C and B2 B brands within the financial services sector. You ll play a key role in crafting standout content, driving organic performance, and supporting the wider social team to deliver campaigns with impact.

What You ll Be Doing
- Managing organic social media activity across multiple platforms, ensuring consistent, high quality output.
- Producing engaging, innovative content - from ideation and concept development to briefing designers/copywriters and creating assets yourself.
- Leading on podcast and video content production, from planning through to execution.
- Reviewing and analysing the performance of organic campaigns to drive continuous improvement.
- Supporting the Head of Social and wider team with day to day tasks and campaign delivery.
- Working to agreed SLAs and KPIs to ensure efficient, professional execution of all social activity.

What You ll Bring Essential
- 2+ years in an agency social role or 3+ years in house.
- Podcast and Video productions
- Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and LinkedIn.
- Hands on experience creating content including video and podcast production.
- Confident copywriting skills and a creative mindset.
- Excellent analytical ability and a data driven approach.
- Ability to work independently and thrive in a fast paced environment.

Preferred
- Experience within the financial services sector.
- Familiarity with additional channels such as YouTube, Threads, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, Bluesky, Trustpilot, etc.
- Experience using social media management tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite).
- Understanding of FCA guidelines and other relevant regulatory frameworks.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- A calm, positive attitude under pressure and a proactive approach to problem solving.

Why Join Us?

You ll be part of a collaborative, forward thinking team where creativity is encouraged, ideas are valued, and your work genuinely makes an impact. If you re ready to take ownership of exciting social projects and grow your skills in a supportive environment, we d love to hear from you.

Social Media Manager (Podcasts / Video)
